name: Do-Undo benchmark
description: We introduce the Do-Undo task and benchmark to address a critical gap in vision-language models: understanding and generating plausible scene transformations driven by real-world actions. Unlike prior work that relies on prompt-based image generation and editing to perform action-conditioned image manipulation, our training hypothesis requires models to simulate the outcome of a real-world action and then reverse it to the original state. This forward-reverse requirement tests genuine cause-and-effect understanding rather than stylistic or semantic edits.
